name: moodle-teacher
description: The teacher's and the academic office's half of Moodle: enrolments, submissions, attendance, lecturers' grade files checked and turned into gradebook imports.
long_description: Connects your Moodle to Claude from the staff side rather than the student's. Reading: enrolments, course contents, assignments, submissions, the gradebook, attendance registers with absences per student. Lecturers' grade spreadsheets: checked against Moodle (right course, enrolled students, marks that are really numbers) and turned into CSV files for Moodle's gradebook import. Writing, always after you confirm: a mark with feedback on a submission, an announcement, an attendance status. Needs a Moodle web-service token (Preferences > Security keys, or from your Moodle administrator).

moodle_url.title: Moodle web service address
moodle_url.description: Your Moodle address followed by /webservice/rest/server.php — for example https://moodle.example.edu/webservice/rest/server.php. Use the exact host your Moodle knows itself by (with or without www).

moodle_token.title: Moodle token
moodle_token.description: From your Moodle: Preferences > Security keys > Moodle mobile web service. If that page is empty, ask your Moodle administrator for a token.
